title: From $(n+1)$-term subcategories to $(n+1)$-term complexes
summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer. Given an $n$-rigid subcategory $\mathcal{M}$ of an algebraic triangulated category $\mathcal{T}$, we explicitly construct an extriangulated functor from the $(n+1)$-term subcategory of $\mathcal{T}$ generated by $\mathcal{M}$ to the full subcategory of $(n+1)$-term complexes in the bounded homotopy category $K^b(\mathcal{M})$, which restricts to the identity on $\mathcal{M}$.
